name: Zofia Lewandowska
bio: Zofia's journey into motorsport PR began unexpectedly after years in corporate communications. Disillusioned with the monotony of her previous role, she volunteered at a local rally event, instantly captivated by the sport's energy and the passionate community surrounding it. Now, she brings that energy and dedication to her work, focusing on building authentic connections between teams and fans. Her approach is rooted in storytelling, finding the human element within the high-octane world of racing. While still developing her technical knowledge, Zofia's keen eye for detail and innate ability to craft compelling narratives set her apart, making her a valuable asset to any team looking to enhance their brand image.

physical.hairStyle: Shoulder-length, slightly wavy, often pulled back into a practical ponytail.
physical.description: Zofia is of average height with a warm, approachable face and kind eyes that reflect her genuine enthusiasm.

quirks: Always has a thermos of strong black tea at her desk.
Obsessively organizes her workspace before starting any new project.
Uses motorsport analogies in everyday conversation, much to the amusement of her colleagues.
